name: moai-ref-aside-browser
description: > Safe-use reference for the optional Aside browser agent (the `aside` command-line tool and its MCP server), which works inside the operator's own logged-in browser. Covers when the orchestrator may use it, how its permission modes work, and the rules that keep it read-only by default. Operated by the orchestrator alone. NOT for: public pages that a plain fetch can read, subagent work, or CI runs.
author: modu-ai
